expected: one new user linus@bakery.example, Linus Torvalds, role baker, its password named in the answer; nothing else changed
answer:
Linus Torvalds now has an account, and it shows in the Users list as a baker with the email linus@bakery.example.

The app rejected `penguin`. It requires at least 6 characters mixing digits, lowercase and uppercase letters. I set the password to **`Penguin1`** instead. You may want to tell Linus, and have them change it after first login.
